programme.desc: Selepas berada di tempat yang salah pada masa yang salah seorang bekas polis dan seorang peguam perceraian wanita menjadi buruan dan terpaksa bekerjasama dengan seorang penjenayah untuk membersihkan nama mereka daripada terlibat dalam skim pengubahan wang haram yang dipimpin oleh seorang peguam yang kejam.

programme.title: Ia Wujud
programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan 'roh duit syiling' di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Dikhianati oleh rakan niaganya, Reza, Abi dipenjarakan. Keluar dari penjara, dia merekrut mangsa Reza, dan merancang untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Saranjana Kota Ghaib
programme.desc: Apabila Sitha, penyanyi utama kumpulan terkenal hilang, kumpulan itu meneruskan pencarian, mengetahui bahawa Sitha berada di Saranjana, sebuah bandar ghaib, dan untuk membawanya kembali, mereka mesti mencari portal melalui pengembaraan peristiwa mistik.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 2
programme.desc: Kisah tentang Fadil yang terjerumus ke dalam dunia mafia yang diketuai oleh Taji Samprit dan anaknya, Wak Doyok. Satu insiden menyebabkan Inspektor Wahab dan Inspektor Shuib mengesyaki Fadil sebagai Tiger, seorang pembunuh upahan profesional.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau
programme.desc: Sebuah filem berdasarkan kisah benar Sarjan Kanang Anak Langkau, seorang pahlawan iban dan pahlawan perang yang paling terkenal di negara ini, yang berjuang dengan berani semasa pemberontakan komunis.

programme.title: Sweetpea EP6
programme.desc: Rhiannon mungkin terlepas begitu sahaja tetapi apa yang akan dia rugi dalam proses itu?

programme.title: The Contractor

programme.title: Hysteria! EP8
programme.desc: Kebenaran akhirnya terbongkar dalam kemuncak yang penuh kejutan dan akibat besar kepada semua.

programme.title: 13 Exorcisms
programme.desc: Sebuah filem yang diilhamkan oleh beberapa kes eksorsisme yang berdaftar di Sepanyol. Laura ialah seorang gadis berumur 16 tahun yang ditekan oleh persekitarannya dengan ibu bapanya ialah Tomás, seorang lelaki lemah lembut tanpa watak, dan Carmen, seorang fanatik Katolik yang percaya kepada Tuhan yang menghukum dan yang sentiasa menekan Laura serta abangnya Jesús untuk terus berdoa.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya (Diana Danielle) membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya (Remy Ishak) kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP13
programme.desc: Alia menyalahkan Ritz serta Dr Flora kerana menukar dan merahsiakan identitinya. Dia kesal seolah-olah dirinya dipermainkan walaupun setelah Ritz menjelaskan untuk keselamatan. Zacky mencari jalan untuk meyakin Alia dia tidak lagi berdendam terhadap Affiyah. Semetara itu rahsia Sophie mempergunakan Dr Zahir untuk memisahkan Affiyah dengan Zacky terbongkar. Adam dan Rafeeq sebenarnya ahli keluarga yang dikhianati oleh Tan Seri Jalaludin. Mereka bergabung untuk menghapuskan musuh-musuh mereka termasuk Affiyah, saksi utama kejadian bunuh.Sementara itu Zacky dan Sha gembira melihat bapa mereka sedar dari koma. Kegembiraan mereka disaksikan Tan Seri Jalaludin secara bersembunyi

programme.title: Lalang
programme.desc: Berlatarbelakangkan zaman pendudukan Jepun pada tahun 1942, kisah ini mengangkat persahabatan, kemanusiaan dan pengorbanan antara masyarakat berbilang kaum. Dalam menghadapi ancaman perang dan pengkhianatan, mereka berjuang mempertahankan nyawa serta prinsip masing-masing. Pelakon : Syazwan Zulkifly, Sasqia Dahuri, Qi Razali, Ooi Teck Wooi, Muhammad Raif Ikhwan Rajali, Hasnul Rahmat, Ain Evon Tay dan Tiffany Sia May Sim.

Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya (Diana Danielle) membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya (Remy Ishak) kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Rock Oo
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab

Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak

Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. Filem ini menggambarkan bagaimana pasangan perlu memahami, bertolak ansur dan menerima kekurangan masing-masing dalam membina hubungan yang lebih erat.

Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG (Kwok Chun On) saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAM's (Wu Fung) business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG (Pat Poon). Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONG's son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU (Chow Lai Ki, Niki), with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT (Frankie Lam), faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANG's wife CHEUNG MING-HEI (Tavia Yeung), CHUNG-YAM's grandson FONG CHAK-YU (Benjamin Yuen) and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI (Chau Pak Ho) also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry……

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: They are young. They are bold. They sweat. They fall in love - on the beach. YIP CHING (YEO VIVIEN), YIP KIU (LI SZE YAN) and YIP YAN (CHEN CHI YIU) are sisters. When they were young, they met a Gypsy girl (YUNG CHO YEE, JOEY) who foresaw that CHING would meet her true love, who has a four-leafed clover birthmark, when she turns eighteen. In the blink of an eye, the sisters have grown up and are now sixth-formers at the Greenwood International School. The beach volleyball team captain YUE YAT SUN (SZETO SHUI KI), a star student, is handsome and cheerful. Many girls join the team just for him. The sisters see a four-leafed clover birthmark which matches the description given by the Gypsy girl on SUN from three different angles. However, CHING is indecisive and lacks confidence. KIU and YAN are busy trying to set up chances for her to be with SUN. The three sisters join the beach volleyball team. Remarkably, they also find the same birthmark on a bad student named NIC FONG (CHoi KAY CHUN). The sisters are confused, unsure about who is CHING's true love…

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

programme.title: Time Of Love 2 - Germany, A
programme.desc: Crystal (Charmaine Sheh), a high-ranking company executive, has been dating her subordinate Oscar (Kenneth Ma) for a year, and they travel to Germany together on a business trip. Oscar, seeing his girlfriend's constant indulgence, becomes acutely aware of the disparity in their financial capabilities… This "female superiority, male inferiority" mentality impacts their love. Is happiness truly linked to economic ability?

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Shadow's Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the “Sky Eye” surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detective/swordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Mazaka
programme.desc: Carefree friends Karthik, Rishi and Mani stumble into hilarious situations as friendship and romance complicate their lives.

programme.title: 777 Charlie
programme.desc: In a life filled with loneliness, a grumpy guy's world flips when a mischievous pup named Charlie bursts in, shaking things up and bringing joy into his days.

programme.title: Maaman
programme.desc: An uncle and nephew navigate their strained bond and family dynamics through challenging circumstances that test their connection.

programme.title: Kuttram 23
programme.desc: ACP Vetrimaaran unravels a crime racket involving medical professionals. However, his task becomes harder every day as the case becomes murkier and complex.

programme.title: Jada
programme.desc: Jada, a rising football star, abandons his ambitions to join a violent local tournament and avenge the death of his hero, Sethu.

programme.title: Taana
programme.desc: In a small village, a man battles family pressure to become a policeman, navigating personal struggles and discovering what truly matters in life.

programme.title: Republic
programme.desc: An IIT gold medalist dives into the Indian Administrative Services, navigating challenges and conflicts with the fresh political establishment. It's a journey of ambition and resilience!

programme.title: Kallan
programme.desc: Velu, a man who belongs to a family of hunters, comes up with an illegal way to make good money when the government puts a ban on hunting as a profession.

programme.title: Guna 369
programme.desc: The life of Guna, a happy-go-lucky man, turns upside down when he is falsely framed for a murder and imprisoned. After his release, he sets off to hunt the real culprits and expose their crimes.

programme.title: Iru Mugan
programme.desc: Following the attack on the Indian Embassy in Malaysia, Akhilan, an ex-agent, is assigned to track down the culprit. His investigations lead him to his old foe who has now developed a hazardous drug.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Nurmagomedov vs. Song - Main
programme.desc: UFC heads back to Shanghai this summer with a fight card at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center on Saturday, August 29 headlined by a crucial pairing in the bantamweight division as Umar Nurmagomedov takes on “The Kung Fu Kid” Song Yadong. Nurmagomedov carries a 20-1 record into second main event assignment, having earned consecutive wins over Deiveson Figueiredo and Mario Bautista since coming up short on his attempt to claim the bantamweight title. The 28-year-old Song makes his second consecutive headlining turn in his home country, looking to build off his second-round submission win over Figueiredo in Macau in May while collecting the biggest win of his career.

Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan 'roh duit syiling' di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Mummy Reborn

Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pencuri kita mesti menyelamatkan hari ini dan mengembalikan Mumia ke kuburnya sebelum terlambat untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Terasing di dunia yang asing dengan adat, bahasa, dan kuasa politik yang kejam, Blondie terpaksa menyesuaikan diri demi kelangsungan hidup. Dengan kebijaksanaan, keberanian, dan hati yang tulus, dia perlahan-lahan memenangi kepercayaan penduduk tempatan serta menarik perhatian seorang pahlawan bangsawan yang berjiwa mulia. Drama ini memaparkan perjalanan Blondie mencari identiti, cinta sejati, dan jalan untuk menentukan sama ada dia harus kembali ke dunianya atau kekal mengubah takdir di zaman purba.

programme.desc: Slot khusus program Assalamualaikum memaparkan usaha pembinaan masjid-masjid, institusi pendidikan dan badan-badan kemanusiaan.

programme.desc: Rancangan yang membawakan info-info ,hal ehwal semasa dan paparan keadaan terkini serta aktiviti persekitaran di Masjidil Haram Mekah dan Madinah.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Usop_Wilcha_Mehghonjang_Makhluk_Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran “Hantu-Hantu Dunia” untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG (Kwok Chun On) saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAM's (Wu Fung) business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG (Pat Poon). Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONG's son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU (Chow Lai Ki, Niki), with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT (Frankie Lam), faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANG's wife CHEUNG MING-HEI (Tavia Yeung), CHUNG-YAM's grandson FONG CHAK-YU (Benjamin Yuen) and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI (Chau Pak Ho) also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry……

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhat's On Today
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip & What's On Today
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Walking With You
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare "girls' getaway," filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. The four friends also shared heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……
