programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip & What's On Today
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Shock Mystery (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. The production team of " Shock Mystery" has collected hundreds of strange and unusual cases from around the world, most of which cannot be explained from the perspectives commonly accepted by people—unless supernatural phenomena truly exist in our world! This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today!

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club's top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Joe is a 20-something slacker who only takes one thing seriously: his on-and-off girlfriend Flora. After their latest breakup, Joe goes to an audition for a documentary by director Barbara Wong. Handed a camera, Joe records his discovery of a magical website that reunites him with Flora at the price of breaking up his best friend and his girlfriend. However, despite the efficiency of the website, Joe's refusal to change his immature ways and Flora's attraction to a talented graffiti artist threatens to break them up once more.

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmer's role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his family's reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Cape No. 7
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect 'partners', Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways…

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: Captain Lin Lang and his elite mercenary team are tasked with escorting a mysterious woman safely home. Bearing the highest bounty in dark web history, she draws assassins from across the globe. Among them is the notorious fugitive Ray. Now, Lin and his team must survive a deadly fight to complete their mission.

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friend's family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friend's company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Cham's wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu”.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Warrior
programme.desc: After challenging the powerful gangster Guru, Sathya is forced to leave the city. He returns as a DSP, vowing to seek revenge.

programme.title: Irandam Ulagaporin Kadaisi Gundu
programme.desc: Selvam hopes to buy his own lorry and marry his lover Chittu. However, his dreams are disrupted when he ends up with an unexploded bomb.

programme.title: Vantha Rajavathaan Varuven
programme.desc: Aadhi, posing as a driver, tries to reunite his grandfather with his estranged daughter Nandhini, but unexpected troubles arise in the process.

programme.title: Kottukkaali
programme.desc: A young woman rejects her arranged marriage for the man she loves from a lower caste. Her shocked family takes her to a seer, believing she is under a spell.

programme.title: Goli Soda
programme.desc: In Koyambedu market, four carefree coolie boys start a mess to earn respect and identity, transforming their lives and friendships along the way.

programme.title: Shivanagam
programme.desc: Naganika's family is in charge of an ancient monument that Kapali has his eyes set on. When Kapali kills her to seek the monument, Naganika is reborn as a snake in her next life to seek revenge.

programme.title: Pongaluku Varugirom
programme.desc: Ex-cop Y.D. Raju agrees to assist his ex-girlfriend ACP Meenakshi in a high-profile kidnapping case. He finds himself in a fix when his wife, Bhagyalakshmi, insists on accompanying them.

programme.title: Dhanusu Raasi Neyargalae
programme.desc: A man ends up falling in love with a girl he meets during his ex-lover's wedding. However, they part ways as he believes in astrology while she being an astronaut believes in astronomy.

programme.title: Kaalidas
programme.desc: A cop, who suffers from family issues, takes up a peculiar suicide case. The plot thickens as similar cases get reported within a span of a few days.

programme.title: Kalki 2898 Ad
programme.desc: The future of those in the dystopian city of Kasi is altered when the destined arrival of Lord Vishnu's final avatar launches a war against darkness.

programme.desc: Dengan helahnya yang licik, Deanna berjaya mendapatkan dewan perkahwinan impiannya. Semuanya tampak sempurna menuju hari bahagia sehinggalah Deanna kehilangan ramuan utama sebuah perkahwinan - pengantin lelaki!

programme.desc: Reeza cuba cari sebab kenapa Rasya berubah tiba-tiba. Reeza nak jumpa keluarga Rasya. Reeza nak keluarga mereka kenal dengan siapa mereka berkawan. Reeza ajak Rasya jumpa mama Rasya dahulu. Rasya dalam dilema.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Semasa sibuk menyiapkan dewan untuk program Jihad palestine, teman lelaki Qasih bernama Rudy datang dengan berseluar pendek, membawakan makanan untuk Qasih dan kehadirannya betul-betul memalukan Khatijah. Selepas Program berkenaan Khatijah memarahi Qasih sambil meluahkan rasa tidak senangnya dengan lelaki yang Qasih pilih. Alawiyah dan Khatijah meneruskan rancangannya untuk merapatkan Jazlan dan Qasih dengan menganjurkan Program Buka Kitab di rumah Alawiyah dengan Jazlan sebagai penceramahnya. Dan semasa ceramah berlangsung, Qasih telah mengajukan soalan kepada Ustaz Jazlan bagaiamanakah seorang ustaz itu boleh bercinta sekiranya ustaz berkenaan asyik tundukkan saje mukanya dan tidak berani memandang akan muka perempuan ?

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP6
programme.desc: Madam Kwan teringat kembali kisah sebenar. Vince, anaknya, ialah pedofil yang menculik Kasyorga dan Hamdi. Uncle Lim

programme.title: The Equalizer S1 EP1
programme.desc: Seorang bekas ejen CIA yang misteri dan menggunakan kemahirannya yang luas untuk membantu mereka yang tidak mempunyai tempat lain untuk meminta pertolongan. Ketika McCall menyesuaikan diri dengan kehidupan sebagai orang awam, dia terdorong untuk menggunakan sumber yang dimilikinya bagi membantu Jewel (Lorna Courtney), seorang remaja yang dituduh membunuh dan sedang diburu oleh penjenayah yang telah memerangkapnya atas jenayah tersebut

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza; mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Jin Qorin
programme.desc: Seno sangat menyayangi isterinya Alya dan anak perempuannya Reva. Namun begitu, ada satu rahsia besar yang mesti disembunyikan olehnya dalam rumah tangga.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK), kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato' Hashim. Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP5
programme.desc: Rodi diburu polis selepas membunuh Rajoo demi menyelamatkan ibunya, Juita, yang akhirnya terbunuh. Kesnya jadi sensasi media, mengangkat isu ketidakadilan sosial terhadap anak jalanan seperti Kasyorga.

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP6
programme.desc: Madam Kwan teringat kembali kisah sebenar. Vince, anaknya, ialah pedofil yang menculik Kasyorga dan Hamdi. Uncle Lim

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhat's On Today
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip & What's On Today
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026

The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. programme.title: Big Boys Club

The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Tang Mist & What's On Today

Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Married But Available

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it.
